title: MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ - JURADO) relative to a personal services contract with Madison McCabe to provide expert communication services for the Thirteenth…
text:
[Council File 26-1569]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (SOTO-MARTINEZ - JURADO) relative to a personal services contract with Madison McCabe to provide expert communication services for the Thirteenth Council District, for the term of November 1, 2026 to October 31, 2027 with a not-to-exceed amount of $33,000.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. APPROVE the personal services contract, attached to the Motion, with Madison McCabe for providing services to the Thirteenth Council District as set forth therein.
2. AUTHORIZE the Councilmember, Thirteenth District, to execute this contract on behalf of the City.
3. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to encumber the necessary funds against the Contractual Services Account of the Council Fund for Fiscal Year 2026-­2027, and to reflect it as a charge against the budget of the involved Council Office.

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted (Nov 10, 2026); Council action final
